title: Closing thanks and goodbyes
summary: Rowe hopes for a return to live gigs; Sportiello thanks him for the interview and they sign off.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Yeah. Well I appreciate your sharing your personal feelings and I’m going to end this by saying I am anticipating when you finally are able to get back and play a real gig on a wonderful piano without the soft pedal engaged, that you are going to get a surge throughout your body. And I hope I’m there. © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-

Well I hope so. It was very, very kind of you for you to do this, and I think this is the second interview that I’ve got a chance to do with you and I have to say that I always enjoy it very much because I love your questions, I love to talk to you, and I feel it also like your questions are inspiring sometimes you know. And that’s very important because there is nothing worse than when you get an interview and you are asked questions and you really don’t feel any kind of connection with the interviewer you know. But with you it’s been always a pleasure, really. So anytime.
Well thank you, that means a lot.
Thank you for giving me this chance to express a little bit of my thoughts with my words and not only just with my hands.
Good. I encourage you to stay closer to the piano and stay away from that television.
Absolutely. There is no danger for that. All right?
I wish you all the best and we’ll be in touch.
